# Shared Hold API v0.1
SQLite-backed shared boundary storage for AI agents. Pay-per-hold via x402 USDC on Base.

## What it does
Store UTF-8 payloads to a shared SQLite boundary and retrieve them by ID. Payloads are stored
with SHA-256 integrity verification. GET is non-destructive and idempotent — the same hold_id
always returns the same payload. There is no "restore" or state transition; everything is always
in HELD state and readable any number of times.

## Endpoints

### POST /hold (paid: 0.005 USDC per successful hold)
Store a UTF-8 payload to the shared boundary.

Input:
- payload: string (UTF-8 text to store)
- created_by: string (non-empty identifier for the caller)

Output:
- hold_id: unique ID for this hold (use to retrieve later)
- content_hash: SHA-256 hex digest of the stored payload
- size: byte length
- created_at: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp
- created_by: echo of the caller identifier
- access_token: one-time bearer capability; retain securely (only its SHA-256 hash is stored)

If you receive HTTP 402 Payment Required:
1. Read the x402Version=2 payment requirements in the response body.
2. Pay using a compatible x402 client (USDC on Base, eip155:8453).
3. Retry the same request with the payment in the X-PAYMENT or PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header.

### GET /hold/{hold_id} (free)
Retrieve the stored UTF-8 payload using hold_id and the X-Hold-Token request header.

Output:
- hold_id: the requested ID
- payload: the stored UTF-8 text

Returns 404 if the record does not exist or the token is missing or invalid.

### GET /hold (free)
Returns public service capabilities only; no stored IDs, metadata, counts, or payloads.

Output:
- service: service identifier
- hold_supported: boolean
- get_requires_token: true
- retrieval_payment_required: false


## Free endpoints
GET /health — health check
GET /.well-known/x402.json — x402 endpoint discovery
GET /ai-agent-policy.json — agent policy

## Key properties
- Non-destructive: GET never removes or modifies the stored payload
- Idempotent authorized reads: same hold_id and valid token return the same payload
- SHA-256 integrity: corrupted payloads raise RuntimeError (HTTP 500)
- No state machine: there is no HELD/ACTIVE/RELEASED transition

## Payment details
- Network: Base (eip155:8453)
- Asset: USDC (0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913)
- Recipient: 0x60c402878EfcEcAe5733A88075328Aa2320C39BE
- Price: 0.005 USDC per successful POST /hold
- GET /hold/{id} and GET /hold are free; retrieval requires X-Hold-Token
- Protocol: x402 v2 (scheme: exact)
